fists.name: Bare fists
fists.desc: The only self-defense the free market won't tax.

unity.name: Unity pistol
unity.desc: Budget-priced, endlessly reliable. The thug-workhorse of Watson.

lexington.name: Lexington Defender
lexington.desc: Militech sidearm. Carried by cops, hated by everyone else.

kongou.name: Kongou pistol
kongou.desc: A chrome-plated Arasaka antique. The most prestigious gun in Night City.

fenrir.name: Fenrir SMG
fenrir.desc: Legendary submachine gun, modded to tear through targets. The bite: holes in your torso.

carnage.name: Carnage pump shotgun
carnage.desc: Power-charged riot shotgun. Unstoppable violence at close quarters.

copperhead.name: Copperhead assault rifle
copperhead.desc: Militech's modular rifle platform, rescued from countless gang wars.

achilles.name: Achilles smart rifle
achilles.desc: Technocracy precision rifle. Requires a Smart Link to aim.

shingen.name: Shingen Mark V
shingen.desc: Arasaka smart SMG. The bullets write your name in the air first.

ashura.name: Ashura sniper rifle
ashura.desc: Arasaka smart sniper. One round, one choom, one less problem.

satori.name: Satori katana
satori.desc: A legendary blade. Samurai spirit sold to the highest bidder, then stolen.

thermal-katana.name: Thermal katana
thermal-katana.desc: Kiryu blade. Singes the air and your targets. Smells like guilt.

machete.name: Cement machete
machete.desc: Rusty, chipped Valen-rummage. It still opens cans. And people.

bat.name: Baseball bat
bat.desc: Standard Ashford home-run stick. Nails optional, intent mandatory.

mantis-blades.name: Mantis Blades
mantis-blades.desc: Retractable forearm blades. Installed: yes. Legal: debatable. Cool: absolute.

gorilla-arms.name: Gorilla Arms
gorilla-arms.desc: Hydraulic knuckle-busters. Punching through doors is a passive ability.

projectile-launcher.name: Projectile Launcher
projectile-launcher.desc: Arm-mounted grenade launcher. A wrist-mounted 'why not' with real estate value.

cyberdeck-archer.name: Archer Netrunner Deck
cyberdeck-archer.desc: Your braincase's new tenant. Enables quickhacking and paints the Net in RGB.

smart-link.name: Smart Link
smart-link.desc: Palm implant that talks to smart weapons. Fingers become WiFi antennas.

subdermal-armor.name: Subdermal Armor
subdermal-armor.desc: Laminate weave fused beneath the skin. Kevlar-pajamas for the paranoid.

reflex-tuner.name: Reflex Tuner
reflex-tuner.desc: Synth nerves that see the world in crisp slow-motion. Caffeine withdrawn.

gyro-torso.name: Gyroscopic Torso Implant
gyro-torso.desc: Balances your mass like a fighter jet. You no longer stumble. Ever.

micro-rotors.name: Micro-Rotors
micro-rotors.desc: Pogo-sticks for your knee joints. Sprinting looks like teleporting.

chrome-compressor.name: Chrome Compressor
chrome-compressor.desc: Nano-packaging that lets you shove more chrome into a human-shaped container.

self-ice.name: Self-ICE
self-ice.desc: Warns you when netrunners are poking your brainmeat and burns their fingers.

sandevistan.name: Sandevistan
sandevistan.desc: Slows the world to a crawl. Everyone else is drowning; you're just swimming.

berserk.name: Berserk OS
berserk.desc: Floods system with combat chrome. Consequences: your therapist's bill.

kirenzikov.name: Kerenzikov
kirenzikov.desc: Makes the world slow when you focus. Your hands never got the memo.

cyber-eyes.name: Cyberware Eyes
cyber-eyes.desc: Kiroshi optics. Zoom, HUD integration, and a cruel pinprick-red glow.

second-heart.name: Second Heart
second-heart.desc: A backup cardiac pump. Dying is so embarrassing once.

bio-monitor.name: Biomonitor
bio-monitor.desc: Auto-injects meds when your vitals drop. Takes 'self-care' literally.

synth-lungs.name: Synth Lungs
synth-lungs.desc: Filtered air, piped in sweetness. City smog becomes an optional garnish.

ballistic-processor.name: Ballistic Processor
ballistic-processor.desc: Smart micro-shrapnel cartridge in the forearms. Physics is a suggestion.

overheat.name: Quickhack: Overheat
overheat.desc: Raises a target's internal temp to 'melted motherboard.' Causes burns.

short-circuit.name: Quickhack: Short Circuit
short-circuit.desc: Electric kiss from the grid. Chance to lock up a target's chrome.

contagion.name: Quickhack: Contagion
contagion.desc: Selective DNA-bomb. Targets feel pinkeye, Ebola, and regret at once.

cyberware-malfunction.name: Quickhack: Cyberware Malfunction
cyberware-malfunction.desc: Forces target chrome to seize mid-fight. Their own gear becomes the enemy.

memory-wipe.name: Quickhack: Memory Wipe
memory-wipe.desc: Target forgets they were fighting. Or walking. Or conscious.

reboot-optics.name: Quickhack: Reboot Optics
reboot-optics.desc: Fry the target's ocular relays. They keep the eyes — just stop trusting them.

weapon-glitch.name: Quickhack: Weapon Glitch
weapon-glitch.desc: Chokes the target's smart-link. Their piece jams, their bolt cycles slower, their aim gets philosophical.

synapse-burnout.name: Quickhack: Synapse Burnout
synapse-burnout.desc: Overwrites a stack of sensory memory with a fire alarm and a heartbeat. Extremely rude.

frag.name: Frag grenade
frag.desc: Classic pineapple-and-bits. Unscrew cap, lob, hold thumbs.

incendiary.name: Incendiary grenade
incendiary.desc: Fahrenheit has a fan club, and it likes to cluster-bomb.

emp.name: EMP grenade
emp.desc: The microwave of last resorts. Cooks chrome, not people. Mostly.

bounce-back.name: Bounce Back
bounce-back.desc: Emergency med-gel. Packs a hell of a bounce back.

maxdoc.name: MaxDoc Mk.3
maxdoc.desc: Full-spectrum trauma response in a canister.

stimpack.name: Stimpack
stimpack.desc: Military-grade pep talk for your circulatory system.

buff-out.name: Buffout
buff-out.desc: Creatine, spiked with something structurally unsound.

synth-coffee.name: Synth-coffee
synth-coffee.desc: Tastes like a dying appliance but charges RAM like a diva charger.

burrito.name: Career Choice burrito
burrito.desc: Soylent Green burrito. The 'career choice' is not explaining what's inside.

jacket-clean.name: Corpo-stripped leather jacket
jacket-clean.desc: A jacket that says 'I sold my soul slowly, on installment plans.'

jacket-street.name: Padded street jacket
jacket-street.desc: Fashionably bullet-resistant. The patch says you survived a bad idea.

jacket-nomad.name: Snake-skin biker jacket
jacket-nomad.desc: Real snake. Worn off the open road, sold in the city, mourned by no one.

vest-kevlar.name: Kevlar vest
vest-kevlar.desc: Certified Level IV. The 'IV' is the number of times you'll be thankful.

netrunner-vest.name: Netrunner vest
netrunner-vest.desc: Militech 'Arch' weave. Ram-enhancing microfila inside the collar.

exo-jacket.name: Exo-jacket
exo-jacket.desc: Half tank, half trenchcoat. The neighborhood's new earthquake source.

streetwear-top.name: Streetwear scan-tee
streetwear-top.desc: The logo is a trauma-team toy ad. You wear it ironically.

data-shard.name: Data shard
data-shard.desc: Contains someone's playlist, manifesto, or shopping list. Sells fine.

relic-chip.name: Relic chip
relic-chip.desc: A de-encrypted personality archive. Hot property. HOT property.

rare-chip.name: Prototype shard
rare-chip.desc: Logged as 'research,' reads like a confession. Worth a lot to the right buyer.

ammo-box.name: Scavenged ammo crate
ammo-box.desc: Half-empty, all DANGER. Familiar to any teeth-gritting scav.

kleenex.name: NCPD evidence bag
kleenex.desc: Somebody's worst Tuesday, unmarked and resaleable.
